locationReview.name: Dr. Al Hogg Pavilion
locationReview.siteGrain: Named building on Peace Arch Hospital campus
locationReview.locationNote: The HealthLink directory point and returned named OSM building centroid differ by about 180 metres. The operator confirms the shared campus address, but the precise building and historical directory match remain unresolved. No point is assigned.

locationReview.name: Vancouver General Hospital — Leon Judah Blackmore Pavilion
locationReview.siteGrain: Named building on Vancouver General Hospital campus
locationReview.locationNote: Operator campus plan names Blackmore Pavilion at 855 West 12th Avenue and locates it beside Jim Pattison. The named OSM building-centre point is used. Its address tag 818 West 10th Avenue conflicts with the operator; that address is not adopted or used as an alias. The point is a representative building location, not an entrance or additional independent hospital.

locationReview.name: Vancouver General Hospital — Banfield Pavilion
locationReview.siteGrain: Named long-term-care building on Vancouver General Hospital campus
locationReview.locationNote: Operator names Banfield Pavilion at 2785 Ash Street and identifies it as long-term care on the VGH campus. The returned named OSM building at the same address provides the representative centre point. It is not an additional independent acute hospital.

locationReview.name: Vancouver General Hospital — Gordon and Leslie Diamond Health Care Centre
locationReview.siteGrain: Named outpatient building beside Vancouver General Hospital campus
locationReview.locationNote: Operator campus plan and published clinical-location address confirm 2775 Laurel Street. Returned named OSM building at that address supplies the representative point. Outpatient building presence does not establish beds or service capacity.

locationReview.name: Vancouver General Hospital — Willow Pavilion
locationReview.siteGrain: Named building on Vancouver General Hospital campus
locationReview.locationNote: Operator campus plan confirms Willow Pavilion at 805 West 12th Avenue; the named OSM building provides a representative centre point. The map does not identify individual wards, entrances, service availability or an independent hospital.

locationReview.name: UBC Hospital — Detwiller Pavilion
locationReview.siteGrain: Named building on UBC Hospital campus
locationReview.locationNote: Operator campus plan distinguishes Detwiller at 2255 Wesbrook Mall from Koerner and Purdy. Returned named OSM building gives the representative centre point. The original directory point is near another part of the campus and is not reused for this separate building.

locationReview.name: UBC Hospital — Purdy Pavilion
locationReview.siteGrain: Named building on UBC Hospital campus
locationReview.locationNote: Operator campus plan distinguishes Purdy at 2221 Wesbrook Mall from Koerner and Detwiller. Returned named OSM building gives the representative centre point. Source directory coordinates are not treated as a shared building point or artificially separated.

locationReview.name: Whitehorse General Hospital
locationReview.siteGrain: Hospital campus, represented at the main hospital building
locationReview.locationNote: Yukon government and operator confirm 5 Hospital Road. OSM returns two named buildings on the same hospital campus; one representative main-building point is used, not two hospitals. Original source province YT is retained despite the BC filename. This is a directory location, not a service-area allocation.

locationReview.name: Holy Family Hospital
locationReview.locationNote: Health authority location page and Providence operator publications confirm 7801 Argyle Street in Vancouver. Returned named OSM node at that address provides a representative location. This is the Vancouver site, not same-named hospitals elsewhere.

method: Explicit exact-source row/alias bindings, independent operator and returned OSM verification, cached published dollar literals. No source contact fields, private absolute paths, synthetic coordinates, clinical capacity or outcome claims. Missing funding stays null; replacement/moved/unverified project sites are not assigned to familiar hospital points.
